faqs.question: What is BLIXER 2 used for?
faqs.answer: BLIXER 2 is a compact blender/mixer used to prepare texture-modified meals and general kitchen items, capable of liquifying, chopping, grinding, puréeing, and emulsifying raw or cooked ingredients.

faqs.question: What is the bowl capacity of BLIXER 2?
faqs.answer: The stainless steel bowl holds 2.9 L, suited to single-portion or small-batch processing.

faqs.question: How powerful is the BLIXER 2 motor?
faqs.answer: It runs on a 1 HP, single-phase, direct-drive induction motor at a single speed of 3450 RPM.

faqs.question: Can BLIXER 2 preserve nutritional value when changing food texture?
faqs.answer: Yes, it processes ingredients to soft, puréed, or liquid textures while retaining the full composition and nutritional value of the original meal.

faqs.question: Is BLIXER 2 easy to clean between batches?
faqs.answer: Yes, all food-contact components come apart and are dishwasher-safe, keeping turnaround quick between uses.

faqs.question: What safety features does BLIXER 2 include?
faqs.answer: It includes a magnetic safety system and a motor brake, along with a heavy-duty composite motor base for reliable daily use.

faqs.question: Can I add ingredients while BLIXER 2 is running?
faqs.answer: Yes, the leakproof, see-through lid can be opened mid-process to add ingredients without stopping the batch.

faqs.question: How is BLIXER 2 different from larger Blixer models?
faqs.answer: BLIXER 2 is the smallest, single-portion model in Robot-Coupe's 16-model Blixer range, suited to lower-volume prep, while larger models scale up in bowl capacity and motor power for higher-volume kitchens.

longForm.heroHook: Small batches, fine results. Blend, chop, grind, purée, and emulsify in one compact unit.
longForm.heroLead: Texture-modified meal prep shouldn't need a full production kitchen behind it. BLIXER 2 handles small batches with the same precision as its larger siblings. A 1 HP direct-drive induction motor runs the twin-blade, fine-serrated "S" blade assembly at 3450 RPM inside a 2.9 L stainless steel bowl, turning raw or cooked ingredients into soft, puréed, or liquid textures in seconds. The leakproof, see-through lid opens mid-process for adding ingredients on the fly, and a bowl scraper arm with lid wiper keeps every bit of food actually processed and used.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: BLIXER 2 product information: motor design, texture functions, and construction details.
body: A 1 HP direct-drive induction motor runs without a belt, built for intensive daily use in a commercial or healthcare kitchen.
The motor operates at a single speed of 3450 RPM, with a pulse switch available for finer cutting precision when a job calls for it.
Inside the 2.9 L stainless steel bowl, a fine-serrated, twin-blade "S" assembly handles chopping, grinding, puréeing, and emulsifying in the same unit.
The leakproof, see-through lid can be opened mid-process, letting ingredients be added while the batch is running without stopping to check progress blind.
A bowl scraper arm and lid wiper work together during operation, keeping ingredients fully processed and the lid clear for visibility.
The stainless steel bowl comes with a handle for secure gripping and easy pouring once a batch is finished.
A magnetic safety system and motor brake are built in as standard, alongside a heavy-duty composite motor base built to withstand daily commercial use.
All food-contact components come apart for cleaning, dishwasher-safe, so turnaround between batches stays quick.

sections.title: Texture-Modified Meal Preparation
sections.description: Preparing meals to a modified texture usually means a trade-off between safety and nutrition, unless the equipment is built to avoid that trade-off entirely. BLIXER 2 processes raw or cooked ingredients, sweet or savoury, entrées through desserts, into whichever texture level a resident or patient needs, soft, puréed, or fully liquid, without losing the composition or nutritional value of the original meal. That means a modified-texture dessert still delivers the same nutrition as the standard version, not a diluted substitute. The whole process happens in seconds per batch, keeping meal service on schedule even when multiple texture levels need preparing across a single sitting.

sections.title: Cleaning and Safety Design
sections.description: A unit that runs multiple times a day needs to be as easy to clean and safe to operate as it is capable of processing food well.
body: Every food-contact component, bowl, blade assembly, lid, and scraper, comes apart for cleaning and goes straight into a dishwasher, so turnaround between batches doesn't become a bottleneck. On the safety side, a magnetic safety system paired with a motor brake keeps the unit protected during operation, while the heavy-duty composite motor base is built to withstand the wear of repeated daily use in a busy kitchen or care facility.
